message:
The other night, we had a surprise power outage during dinner. I had just finished cooking when the lights flickered and went out. I admit, my first thought was panic—where were my flashlights? But then I remembered my well-stocked emergency drawer! I grabbed a couple of flashlights and a lantern, and suddenly, I felt like a hero. 

Sitting around the table with my family, eating our dinner by lantern light, I realized how nice it felt to be prepared for a change. We shared stories and laughed, turning a little hiccup into a cozy family night. 

Have you had a moment where you felt prepared? I'd love to hear your tips for making power outages a bit more bearable! 😊
